newsitem.title: USA: Talbots says looks for eps growth in Q2.
newsitem.headline: Talbots says looks for eps growth in Q2.

text.p: Talbots Inc said it continues to look for growth in earnings per share in the second quarter, and it hopes to benefit from increased sales during a semiannual event and from its catalogs.
Talbots said the shortfall in spring catalog sales hurt first quarter results.
The company said, however, it believes this earnings shortfall is a "short term event", due to a new presentation strategy introduced in spring catalogs during the first quarter.

Talbots said it has "worked quickly to make adjustments" to upcoming fall catalogs, which will begin to be distributed in July and August. It said these adjustments should positively benefit sales in the second quarter.
The company also said it will hold its semiannual sales event in June and July.

The company also said it is planning to open 70 new stores in fiscal 1997, while expanding the Talbots Babies concept into existing Talbots Kids stores, and the Talbots Intimates business into existing Talbots Misses stores.
The company said this move would bring the total store count to 605 at the end of fiscal 1997, up from 535 at the end of fiscal 1996.
The company reported earnings per share for the quarter of $0.50 compared to earnings per share of $0.62 for the same period a year ago.
